notes: Narrative density matrix basis. A reading is one interpretation of the company's situation. The diagonal of rho_N is how much the evidence supports each reading; off-diagonals are coherence: two readings nobody has yet been forced to choose between. Everything here is DERIVED from state/campaign_state.json by tools/readings_v1.py; nothing here is world truth and nothing here is written back. Probes are the only vocabulary a reading may use to touch state; add a probe to the tool before you add one here. Witness strings are for the hub readout and writers, never for character mouths. Pass two: readings about the WORLD read belief/intel (outbox/intel.latest.json, state.intel) with truth fallback on a fresh campaign; readings about the COMPANY (roster, promises, debt, the roll) read state. The six questions as Bloch vectors feed the levels at moderate weight.

spine.note: Working spine length for attractor pacing. Not a gate; nothing unlocks on mission number.

coherencePairs.question: Whose war is this?
coherencePairs.gloss: Merc paper and our own ground have not yet been made incompatible.

coherencePairs.gloss: People come back to it; the question is in what condition.

coherencePairs.gloss: You can own ground and still owe for it.

coherencePairs.question: Do we go back for them?

dynamics.note: Coherence c in [0,1] per pair. A distinguishing event multiplies c by (1 - strength) and records which reading it pointed toward. A renewing event moves c toward 1 by strength. rho_ij = c_ij * sqrt(rho_ii * rho_jj).
